ui-chat.attachment.tooLarge: Each attachment must be 8 MiB or less
ui-chat.audit.input: This is the full user text the Runner put together. Below: the role, whether a task was attached, and the SHA-256; the "input handed to the agent" step confirms delivery. What {product} appends to the system layer isn't here — see "Session settings › View this session's prompts" (guideSha256 is its hash).
ui-chat.audit.launch: This is the full text {product} appended to the system layer when this process started (Claude Code's appended system prompt / Codex's developer instructions). Below: the layers, the boot core's version, how it was launched, and the guide files the engine reads itself; where each layer comes from and who can change it is under "Session settings › View this session's prompts".
ui-chat.clipboard.denied: Can't reach the clipboard — select the text and copy it yourself
ui-chat.command.unknown: Unknown command. Refresh with /help, or run it in the native CLI.
ui-chat.composer.label: Message
ui-chat.composer.resizeLabel: Drag to resize the message box (arrow keys adjust; double-click or Home resets)
ui-chat.composer.resizeTitle: Drag to resize the message box; double-click to reset
ui-chat.composer.terminal: Type a command; Enter runs it in the terminal
ui-chat.composer.terminalOffA11y: Turn off running in the terminal
ui-chat.composer.terminalOnA11y: Turn on running in the terminal
ui-chat.composer.terminalStays: Stays on, so you can run several
ui-chat.drop.blocked: Attachments can't be added to this conversation right now
ui-chat.drop.limits: Several files at once · up to 8 per message, 8 MiB each
ui-chat.drop.release: Drop to add to this conversation
ui-chat.earlier.showLoaded: Show {count, plural, one {# earlier turn} other {# earlier turns}} ({total} loaded)
ui-chat.earlier.showTotal: Show {count, plural, one {# earlier turn} other {# earlier turns}} ({total} in all)
ui-chat.identityFresh.confirmNote: Once you confirm, the new profile starts a fresh native conversation: the history here stays, but the AI no longer remembers it.
ui-chat.identityFresh.note: After the profile switch, this conversation's history couldn't be carried over to the new profile (the reason is in the activity). Switch back to the old profile with "/identity" to continue, or continue without the history.
ui-chat.jumpConfirm.note: ⌘/Ctrl+Enter means "jump the queue": it doesn't interrupt the running turn — it is appended to this turn if it can be (the AI reads it at its next tool boundary), otherwise it goes out first after this turn. To interrupt, use "Stop".
ui-chat.openCode.problem: This isn't the one-time passcode {command} open gave (22 letters, digits, - and _). Open the whole link it printed, or copy just the part after #code= in it; the browser may also have filled in some other password — clear it and try again.
ui-chat.qr.label: Pairing QR code
ui-chat.queue.pickHint: Tick to remove several at once; two or more can be merged into one
ui-chat.queue.steerLeft: {count} of them can't be appended to this turn and stay queued
ui-chat.resident.paused: This resident agent is paused: it takes no messages, and its timers are kept but don't fire.
ui-chat.rewind.stillRunning: The rewind is still running; send again in a moment
ui-chat.terminal.connected: Connected · closing the panel doesn't stop the CLI
ui-chat.terminal.inputRetry: Input connection lost, retrying with the same id:
ui-chat.terminal.note: The terminal runs with this session's profile and working folder. Model calls, tool runs and config changes inside the CLI really take effect.
ui-chat.terminal.title: Official native CLI
ui-chat.terminal.truncated: Earlier output is past what is kept
ui-chat.terminalMode.runsNote: The terminal finished {count, plural, one {# command. Your next message sends this command and its output} other {# commands. Your next message sends these commands and their output}} to the AI, so it can see them.
ui-chat.terminalMode.warning: ⚠ Terminal mode: Enter runs the command at once in your server's terminal (your own Linux account, this conversation's working folder), without the AI, and it can't be undone.
ui-chat.trace.idleBackground: · {count} running in the background; the AI continues on its own when they finish or come due
ui-chat.trace.noOutput: This event has no text output
